llm.summary: This appears to be a real PatentMax patent-comparison skill, but it needs review because it sends user patent details to an external paid API and includes broader patent-search capabilities than its narrow description suggests.

dimensions.detail: External PatentMax API access is purpose-aligned and mostly disclosed, but the code accepts PATENTMAX_BASE_URL and sends Authorization headers to that environment-controlled host without an allowlist or HTTPS validation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, dependency fetch, or remote-code execution mechanism was found; the Python client uses the standard library and the skill grants Bash, Read, Write, and Glob for runtime use.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md narrows when to use the skill, while references/tools.md authorizes broader paid patent research workflows and external verification; those extra instructions are disclosed in files but under-scoped relative to the manifest description.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill writes output files and stores a trial key, budget/session state, candidate ledger, and patent cache under ~/.patentmax; this is task-related and partly disclosed, but it can persist patent queries or technical details beyond the immediate run.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main SKILL.md workflow fits patent-claim comparison, but the bundled client and references also cover patent search, statistics, company profiling, citations, figures, reports, budget controls, and candidate ledgers beyond the stated 2-3 patent claim-comparison purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending patent queries, patent numbers, and any pasted technical descriptions to PatentMax/ip930. Avoid entering confidential pre-filing invention details unless that external processing is acceptable, keep PATENTMAX_BASE_URL unset or pinned to the official service, monitor API spending, and be aware that trial keys and task data may be stored locally under ~/.patentmax.
llm.findings:
[TT3] unexpected: Authenticated API calls are expected, but the arbitrary PATENTMAX_BASE_URL redirect risk is artifact-supported and under-disclosed; this supports Review, not a malicious verdict.
[TP4] unexpected: The broad client capabilities and references are real, but they are visible in the package and partly framed as complete PatentMax tool usage rather than hidden behavior.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The concern is supported: references/tools.md includes broader search/report workflows than the claim-comparison manifest describes.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Company profiling, statistics, and external verification exceed what is needed for comparing claims and create avoidable scope expansion.
[LP1] expected: Network access to api.ip930.com is necessary for the stated PatentMax data source and is disclosed, but fine-grained domain scoping is weak.
[E1] expected: Sending patent numbers, searches, and possibly user-provided technical descriptions to PatentMax is central to the service; users need confidentiality and billing awareness rather than treating this as hidden exfiltration.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-only user-facing text is evident throughout the artifact; it is a usability/locale concern but not evidence of deceptive or malicious behavior.
